thought.text: My reporter flag was invalid (vitest v4 doesn't have a "basic" reporter). Let me re-run properly in the background and poll.

reasoning_content:
Oops, `--reporter=basic` isn't a valid reporter in vitest v4 (my mistake — the valid one is `basic` in older versions, and in v4 the reporters are `default`, `verbose`, `dot`, `json`, `junit`, `tap`, `hanging-process`, etc.). I'll rerun with the default reporter and capture the FAIL lines. The suite takes about 5.5 minutes, which exceeds my 580-second timeout — in the first full run the total time was 333 seconds, but it got caught up in timeout... no wait, that's wrong, the first full run (via mise run test-suite) took 333 seconds and fit within 580 seconds. This re-run got killed by my `timeout 580` wrapper, and the log only has startup errors in it (it failed instantly due to the invalid reporter, and "EXIT: 1" came from npm). No wait, actually the log has a startup error written in it, meaning it failed instantly. Exit code 1 came from vitest, not from the timeout.

I'll rerun with the default reporter and a longer approach — running in the background and polling.
